scope: Correct the clean-checkout dependency boundary exposed by a failed Vercel production build while preserving the existing local relay Docker source path.

correction.repository_boundary: GALXAI ignores the two independent repository directories; root knowledge mappings no longer claim ownership of their guides. Their own package checks remain authoritative.
